title: Subprocess shell enabled (shell=True) — review required
description: Running a subprocess with shell=True passes the command through a system shell, where metacharacters in attacker-influenced input become command injection. This lexical rule cannot prove taint — treat every hit as review-required, not as proven exploitable.
remediation: Drop shell=True and pass the command as an argument list (no shell involved). If a shell is unavoidable, never include interpolated or concatenated input — use shlex.quote on every dynamic fragment.
limitation: Lexical, line-based, no dataflow: matches any shell=True flag including fully static commands. os.system/os.popen with dynamic input are separate rules.
